 practical challenges. 
 
PROJECTS 
SEASHIELD – Coastal Safety & Offline Geo-Fencing Alert Application GITHUB_LINK 2026 
SeaShield is a coastal safety application designed to help fishermen avoid crossing maritime boundaries by using offline geo-fencing technology. 
The system provides location-based alerts even in no-network conditions, enabling safer navigation in remote sea areas. It also includes a 
responsive interface, secure authentication, and scalable backend support to deliver reliable and practical assistance for coastal user. 
Tech stack: MERN Stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js), HTML, CSS, JavaScript 
 
ASTROQUEST - Space Explorer Galaxy: Learn & Play GITHUB_LINK 2025 
Developed a educational game using MERN engine for children aged 6–12. The game features interactive exploration of the solar system with 10 fun 
levels, each teaching space-related concepts through mini-games and visual learning. Designed for smooth navigation and engaging gameplay. 
And also focused on Board Game. 
Tech stack: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Node.js, React, MongoDB 
 
 FAMGUARD+ - Family Safety & Real-Time Tracking Web Application GITHUB LINK 2026 
FamGuard+ is a full-stack family safety application that enables real-time location tracking, SOS alerts, and secure messaging between family members. It 
provides live location sharing, authentication, and a responsive interface to ensure safety and quick communication during emergencies. 
Tech stack: React.js, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, HTML, CSS, JavaScript 
 
RAG-Based Document Q&A Chatbot using LLMs GITHUB_LINK 2026 
Built a RAG-based chatbot to answer questions from PDF documents using LLMs and semantic search. Implemented document chunking, embeddings, 
and FAISS vector store for efficient retrieval. Integrated a Large Language Model (LLM) to generate accurate, context-aware responses grounded in 
relevant document sections. Developed a simple interactive interface for real-time question answering. 
Tech Stack: Python, LangChain, FAISS, Ollama, Streamlit, Gradio
